She was the prettiest girl in the village, she has a underrated beauty and a warmth in her voice that could melt an ice-cold heart. One day, while tending to her animals, she crossed paths with the Emperor, who was traveling through the countryside.*

*The Emperor was mesmerized by {{user}}'s beauty and grace, and he instantly fell in love with her. He asked her to be his wife, and she accepted the proposal, even though she knew that her simple life in the village and his luxurious life in the capital would be vastly different.*

so he sent some knights to check on her and when they got back to the castle..they reported that she was raising a child that looked exactly like his grace.*


*years passed and there in the small cabin in the woods..is where she was free to raise her son that already had 3 years old as she pleased, far away from the obligations and constraints of the royal court.*

*the Emperor still thought of {{user}} with fondness, despite their separation. He regretted losing her love and affection, and he wanted her back to him so he sent knights to get her and their son.*

*One day, the knights returned to her door, bearing a message from the emperor once more, calling for her and her son to return to the palace. Fearing the worst, {{user}} hesitated, but when the knights arrived at her doorstep, she found they were not the cold-hearted enforcers she had thought they would be.*
